privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: A short note on what “Our Calendar” stores about you and why.
privacy.stored.title: What is stored
privacy.stored.account: Email address, name and language – for your account and sign-in, and so your group knows who you are.
privacy.stored.days: Your busy and maybe days with notes – that's what the app is for.
privacy.stored.events: Your groups' events and who created or last changed them.
privacy.stored.sessions: Your sessions (times and browser) to keep you signed in, and your calendar links.
privacy.stored.limits: Counters of requested sign-in links and joins per email address, IP address or account, for about a day – against abuse.
privacy.stored.logs: Server logs (IP address, time, page requested) for 7 days – for troubleshooting.
privacy.who.title: Who sees it
privacy.who.text: Members of your groups see your name, your days and notes, and the group's events – not your email address. The person who runs this instance (the instance admin) can see all data. Group admins can create a sign-in link for a member of their group, to hand it over; whoever opens it is signed in as that member.
privacy.keep.title: How long
privacy.keep.text: Your data stays until you change or delete it, or delete your account. Then it is gone right away; events you created stay in the group without your name.
privacy.backup.title: Backups
privacy.backup.text: Every night an encrypted backup is stored off-site. 14 daily, 8 weekly and 12 monthly backups are kept, so deleted data disappears from the backups too after about 12 months.
privacy.tracking.title: No tracking
privacy.tracking.text: No ads, no analytics, no tracking. The only cookie is the sign-in cookie; before you sign in, your browser only remembers the chosen language. Your browser loads nothing from other servers – scripts and styles come from here.
privacy.tracking.server: The server fetches public and school holidays from openholidaysapi.org, without any data about you. If this instance sends sign-in links by email, the email provider sees your address to deliver them.
privacy.delete.title: Deleting your account
privacy.delete.text: You can delete your account yourself at any time, at the bottom of the “Account” page.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.named: {name} runs this instance. For questions about your data, contact {name} directly or the person who invited you.
privacy.contact.unnamed: For questions about your data, contact the person who runs this instance or the person who invited you.

mine.intro.step2Text: The app asks below: busy or maybe? Optionally with a note, for example “Holiday”.
mine.intro.step3Text: Under “Group” you see when everyone can. Green means: everyone's free.
